response.overview: This release is METALVERSE's first live video work, capturing their solo concert "METALVERSE #3 - GARDEN OF EDEN". Furthermore, it includes many songs that have not been released digitally, making it a special release that allows viewers to check out songs they haven't been able to see or hear before. This release captures the energetic performance of MIKO, SAKIA, and COCONA from METALVERSE, who "appeared" before a sold-out, packed audience. Also noteworthy are the incredible playing of HAL-CA (g/ASTERISM), Li-sa-X (g/KOIAI), Yunika Impact (b/Kakumei Meroik, KOIAI), and Fuwawa (dr/Kakumei Meroik), who participated as part of the girls' band project METALVERSE VΛND PROJECT (MVP).
response.title: METALVERSE #3 - GARDEN OF EDEN
